titles.romaji: Kanpeki Ojousama no Watakushi ga Dogeza de Mazo Ochisuru Choroin na Wakenai desu wa!
titles.native: 完璧お嬢様の私が土下座でマゾ堕ちするちょろインなワケないですわ！

description:
The beautiful and high-class lady Irina Shirogane works as the student council president of Saint Eurora Academy. As the heiress of the Shirogane International conglomerate, she has been schooled from a young age in the same way as emperors would've been on kingship. The great deal of effort she spent which no one else could ever do makes her live up to the name of her magnanimous status.

It was just a mere sudden impulse from Irina to sneak a little peek in the magazines that were confiscated from male students of the school. In articles inside each one are what she thought of as something repulsive. What she saw inside them were indecent pictures showcasing female masochists in highly suggestive poses and with provocative facial expressions.
